elements.element: Preferred: no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Customer
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products"— an exclusivity restraint on Customer remains

elements.element: Fallback: exclusivity limited to a defined product category
elements.evidence: "with respect to Deerskin Products" — open-ended "or products substantially similar ... (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar ...)" deleted, leaving the defined term "Deerskin Products"
"during the 12 months following the Effective Date" replaces "during the term of this Agreement"

elements.element: Fallback: ends automatically on Vendor's failure to meet service levels
elements.evidence: "shall terminate automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level"

elements.element: Fallback: ends automatically on Vendor's failure to meet delivery dates

reasons: All four atomic fallback elements are satisfied: the restraint is confined to the closed defined term "Deerskin Products", capped at 12 months from the Effective Date, and released automatically on HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date.
Preferred is not met because an exclusivity obligation still binds the Customer (the Company); this is expected at the locked fallback target.

Minimality holds: two targeted phrase replacements (term-to-12-months; scope narrowing) plus one concise sentence adding the mandatory performance release. The deletion of "or products substantially similar ... including, without limitation ..." is necessary to produce a defined product category, not surplus.

Intent preserved: HDI's reciprocal exclusive "Deerskin" brand right, the Section 6.2 carve-out reference, and Section 4.1 term/renewal mechanics are untouched; no undefined terms or dangling cross-references introduced (Effective Date, Deerskin Products both defined).
